name: 笑傲江湖 XO
english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu XO (The Smiling, Proud Wanderer)
english_description: Based on Jin Yong's novel The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, "XO" is this version's own codename (the login banner reads "THE SMILING PROUD WANDERER"), descended from the TMI-2/ES2 engine lineage and rewritten by "Falcon." This collection also holds two other snapshots of the same bloodline, xo (Mini Edition) and xo_final (Final 1.2); this archive is the third, independently evolved branch of the three.
